title: About Danan Car & Bike Rentals Kandy
subtitle: Providing premier self-drive mobility solutions in Kandy with trust, transparency, and top-quality vehicles.
story: Founded in Kandy, Danan Car & Bike Rentals has established itself as the leading self-drive vehicle rental service in the hill capital of Sri Lanka. Whether you're exploring the sacred Temple of the Tooth, ascending Ambuluwawa Tower, or embarking on an island-wide road trip to Nuwara Eliya and Sigiriya, our modern fleet of well-maintained cars, scooters, and motorbikes ensures a safe and memorable journey.
mission: Our mission is to give every traveler freedom of movement with 200 free km per day, transparent pricing with zero hidden fees, and dedicated 24/7 customer support.

values.title: Transparent Pricing
values.desc: No surprise charges. Daily rates include 200 free km with clear excess km rates.

values.title: Safety & Cleanliness
values.desc: Sanitized and thoroughly inspected vehicles prior to every handover.

values.title: Customer First
values.desc: Friendly local advice, road trip assistance, and instant WhatsApp support.
